title: Customizable Healthy Life workspace
summary: Resume the unfinished workspace with editable activities, personal habits, optional plans, a persistent focus timer and weekly recorded insights.

changes.detail: Editable recurring activities, per-date rescheduling, custom habits with rest/skip/undo, preview-before-apply plans, restart-persistent timer, sourced lessons, weekly summaries and confirmed local deletion.

Healthy Life opens at /wellness; existing guided routines remain at /wellness/guided using the same wellness store. Existing reminders remain accessible. New workspace content is English with an explicit language notice.
Week navigation moves the selected date; date validation is timezone-independent; recorded habit targets survive later goal edits; countdown rounds consistently.

validation.name: Implementation validation
validation.detail: Typecheck, focused lint, model and interaction regressions pending. Native device and deployment untested. No deployment performed.
